title: Obsidian Energy Announces First Quarter 2026 Results

(TSX: OBE) (NYSE American: OBE) (“Obsidian Energy“, the “Company“, “we“, “us” or “our“) is pleased to report our operating and financial results for the first quarter of 2026.
